title: Especialista em obras marítimas (owner’s engineer)
description:
Estamos estruturando o time do Consórcio Gerenciador (Owner’s Engineer) para um dos mais relevantes empreendimentos de infraestrutura do país. Trata-se de um projeto portuário de grande porte, com solução de engenharia inovadora e elevada complexidade técnica, envolvendo interface com operações logísticas estratégicas e alto nível de exigência em planejamento, gestão e controle.

Por que essa vaga é diferente?

Você será a referência de Obras Marítimas no ciclo completo do projeto da concepção e definição de premissas, passando por projeto executivo, até entrega da obra, garantindo conformidade contratual e ARTESP, com interface contínua com EPC (projetista + construtora).

Modelo e local de trabalho:

Contratação: PJ (tempo indeterminado)

Reporte: Gerente de Engenharia (interface direta e contínua com EPC)

Regime: presencial, com home office em dias a combinar conforme programação semanal

Base inicial: São Paulo — Parque da Cidade (Av. das Nações Unidas, 14401)

Atividades presenciais em Santos ao longo de 2027 (frequência a confirmar)

Responsabilidades da posição:

Metodologia e frentes marítimas (do zero até a entrega)

Ser o ponto focal técnico para as frentes marítimas/portuárias do empreendimento, assegurando que a metodologia seja executável, segura e compatível com as restrições do canal e da navegação. Revisar e validar premissas e métodos construtivos marítimos associados, incluindo dragagens/escavações submersas, preparo de fundação/berço, lastro/reaterro, proteções e intervenções no leito, com foco em construtibilidade, mitigação de riscos e relacionamento com as partes interessadas. Avaliar e orientar o faseamento e as janelas operacionais para etapas críticas (dragagem, posicionamento, imersão, conexão, proteção), considerando requisitos de segurança, contingência e reversibilidade.

Logística marítima e operações (interfaces críticas com o Porto)

Estruturar (junto com EPC) a estratégia de logística marítima: frota/equipamentos, rebocadores, balsas, guindastes flutuantes, embarcações de apoio, áreas de fundeio, rotas internas, abastecimento e planos de prontidão. Coordenar planos de navegação/segurança marítima, sinalização temporária, áreas de exclusão, rotas alternativas e comunicação operacional, minimizando impactos na operação e garantindo previsibilidade para os usuários do canal. Conduzir (pelo Owner’s Engineer) o alinhamento técnico-operacional com autoridades e stakeholders portuários (Autoridade Portuária, Capitania dos Portos/Marinha, VTS quando aplicável, praticagem, terminais e arrendatários), garantindo aderência a requisitos e aprovações.

Gestão de interfaces, riscos e condicionantes ambientais

Liderar a gestão de riscos de frentes marítimas: interferências, instabilidade/assoreamento, turbidez, correntes/maré, clima operacional, segurança de navegação, riscos de colisão/incidentes, e impactos em operações portuárias. Apoiar a definição e acompanhamento de planos de monitoramento e mitigação (hidrossedimentologia, batimetrias, turbidez, qualidade da água), garantindo conformidade com condicionantes e evidências de controle. Avaliar impactos e restrições decorrentes de interferências submersas (dutos/cabos/estruturas existentes), planejamento de desvios/relocações e gestão de evidências.

Governança técnica, qualidade e conformidade (ARTESP/Contrato)

Conduzir revisões técnicas e validações independentes de metodologias, planos de execução marítima, procedimentos, especificações, critérios de aceitação e planos de inspeção/ensaio, garantindo rastreabilidade de decisões e atendimento aos ritos de aprovação. Atuar como consultor, com liderança indireta sobre o time do projetista, construtora e o CQP/certificação, garantindo consistência, completude e auditabilidade dos entregáveis. Suportar tecnicamente temas de mudança e risco: alterações de método/projeto, não conformidades, engenharia de valor e subsídios técnicos para pleitos/claims (sem caráter jurídico).

Requisitos Experiência sólida em obras marítimas/portuárias (execução e/ou engenharia), com capacidade de atuar como referência técnica (mínimo de 5 anos). Vivência com dragagens, escavações submersas, movimentação de solo/material, proteção de leito e operações com embarcações e equipamentos marítimos. Experiência em planejamento e condução de interfaces com operação portuária, incluindo relacionamento com autoridades marítimas/portuárias e gestão de janelas operacionais. Capacidade de avaliação crítica de metodologia construtiva, logística marítima e gestão de riscos operacionais. Inglês intermediário obrigatório; fluente desejável (interface com EPC/fornecedores internacionais).

Diferenciais Experiência com obras subaquáticas complexas em canal navegável. Experiência com gestão de tráfego aquaviário, planos de navegação, áreas de exclusão e interfaces com VTS/praticagem. Familiaridade com monitoramentos batimétricos/hidrossedimentológicos e gestão de condicionantes ambientais em obra marítima. Experiência com grandes portos e ambientes com alta criticidade operacional (minimização de downtime e gestão de stakeholders).

O que você ganha trabalhando aqui

Participação em um projeto de grande impacto regional e nacional, com solução de engenharia túnel imerso, pioneiro na América Latina.

Experiência única, com atuação em frentes marítimas e operação portuária crítica, integrando metodologia + logística marítima + relacionamento com autoridades portuárias, com participantes internacionais, em um time com tomada de decisão de alto nível.

Processo e remuneração

Valores serão compartilhados com candidatos que avançarem para a próxima etapa.

Na fase seguinte, solicitaremos uma apresentação aos selecionados.

title: Manager, travel services
description:
Before You Apply, Please Read: This is a 100% on-site role in Alphaville (Barueri/SP). No hybrid arrangement is planned in the short term. Independent contractor agreement (PJ), with benefits. The offer will be presented after the interview process. Previous experience with international ticketing in a corporate travel agency is mandatory. At least advanced english is required. 

About Smartrips and Navan

We are the largest Travel Tech in Brazil and an official Navan partner, serving large corporate clients such as Heineken, Visa, and Unilever, among others. Our consultants are a trusted reference for travelers: they resolve the unexpected quickly, anticipate problems, and treat every booking as if it were their own.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop the team Ensure your team is developing through regular review of interactions, coaching sessions, and 1:1 meetings. Communicate clear expectations so consultants are self-driven and motivated to meet and exceed the expectations of their role. Lead consultants through change as an active change agent, ensuring their understanding and encouraging their feedback. Keep your team globally aligned to organizational expectations, quality, process, and performance through team meetings. Support recruitment of Travel Consultants and new hire inductions to ensure team consistency. Highlight and manage employee performance concerns, escalating to the People team or Senior Leadership when necessary. Cascade travel industry updates and changes to your team.

Quality and performance Maintain an in-depth understanding of the daily responsibilities of Travel Consultants. Perform quality evaluations on Travel Consultant interactions, reviewing travel bookings in travel tools and requests to ensure standards of service are consistently excellent. Monitor and highlight any errors, providing constructive feedback and coaching consultants on preventative actions. Regularly review consultant and team performance metrics to identify areas of opportunity in critical core competencies and provide feedback. Monitor contact queues and SLA performance to ensure appropriate adherence and achievement of goals. Supervise Travel Consultant performance against success metrics. Report on weekly and monthly performance of the operation and, specifically, of your team.

Service and operations Receive and resolve email, voice, and chat interactions. Manage escalations and customer communications, owning customer issues through to completion. Partner with all cross-functional teams to address agent errors and learning needs, and suggest ways to improve Travel Consultant performance. Participate in projects to help develop, guide, and implement effective processes with a successful impact on service delivery and results. Work with Operations and Service Leadership to regularly review, update, and share global metrics for success. Monitor and identify processes or procedures impacting team productivity.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of travel industry knowledge leadership experience in a TMC or travel industry contact center environment. 3 years of travel industry experience at Manager level, managing consultants and leads. Hands-on background in international ticketing within a corporate travel agency. A leisure-only profile does not meet the requirement. Advanced knowledge of Sabre and/or Amadeus GDS, as well as online and offline travel operational processes. At least advanced English: you will report, run meetings, and align with global teams in English. Customer-centric: the customer is at the forefront of everything you do. Able to build relationships and motivate team members by sharing knowledge and encouraging engagement. Proven mentor with a clear understanding of travel service requirements, customers, and the challenges facing a fast-growing company. Excellent, professional communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Data-driven, with the ability to apply business analytics to gain deeper, real-time insights into agent performance and trends.

title: Ai operations
description:
About Liora

Liora is an energy fintech: we operate distributed generation assets across Brazil and turn the savings they generate on clients' electricity bills into financial products, credit, cashback and benefits, without increasing what clients pay.

Most people treat their electricity bill as a fixed, unavoidable cost, something you pay and forget.

What they don't realize is that energy has all the characteristics of a financial asset: it's recurring, predictable, and present in virtually every household and business budget. Liora was built on that insight.

The electricity bill stops being a burden and becomes a channel for economic opportunity, especially for the small businesses that traditional finance has always underserved.

We're building an AI-first operation where agents score credit & risk, approve or decline applications, and run ownership transfers across dozens of energy distributors.

This is not an automation project. It is a real business operation with real clients, real volume and real consequences, designed from day one to be run by AI agents.

We are looking for the person who will make it work.

What you'll operate

Credit & Risk

Deciding who is a good payer, who is too risky, and under what terms we should accept each client.

Define and apply credit & risk criteria: evaluate payment behavior, energy consumption and other signals to determine approval, limits and risk. Run and improve the operation:m onitor decisions, portfolio health, default rates and edge cases, turning learnings into better rules and processes. Own the AI agents: define how they analyze applications, what they handle autonomously and where they escalate to you.

Ownership Transfer

Getting every new consumer unit (UC) fully switched over to Liora across dozens of distributors with different rules and systems.

Own the process: map distributor requirements and ensure contracts and documentation are correct. Run and unblock the operation: track transfers, resolve rejections and exceptions, and keep applications moving. Own the AI agents: automate execution, define escalation points and continuously expand what agents can handle.

These are complex, high-volume operations that, in the traditional model, would require large teams. At Liora, we want them run by agents, with you in command.

Who you are

We care less about titles and years of experience than about how you think, learn and solve problems.

You don't need to have done this before. Very few people have. We're looking for someone early enough in their career to be excited by building something from scratch, but ambitious enough to take real ownership from day one.

Degree and industry background don't matter. What matters is that you can move between business judgment and technical execution: understand the problem, build the solution, measure the result and improve it.

You're not waiting for a defined process or formal training to get started. You enjoy figuring things out when there is no obvious answer.

You spend time experimenting with AI agents because you're genuinely curious. You've tested tools, broken things, understood why they broke and tried again.

Why now, why Liora

The energy sector is full of opaque tariffs, fragmented processes and decades of accumulated complexity. Liora is turning that complexity into financial infrastructure for SMBs and high-consumption consumers.

We're backed by Canary, 17 Sigma and 468 Capital. We doubled in size in the first two months of 2026 and project 15x growth by year end.

You'll join while the category is being created, with the autonomy to build the playbook as you go.

The window is open. It won't stay that way forever.

title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Head of accounting
description:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.

We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and Soft Bank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.

This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.

Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.

The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.

You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time. The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P& L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors. Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them. Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it. Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established. Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual. Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out. External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations

The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards. Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them. Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.

Team, Systems, and Standard

Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client. Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across Net Suite, Quick Books Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation. A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant Substantial ERP experience with Net Suite, Quick Books Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, , Rippling, or Flo Qast Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded Saa S or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.

Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.

Why Join Through MAVI

Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day

Work Arrangement

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Domain expert reviewer- art
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified Art Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in art will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse art-related topics.

Key Responsibilities Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering art history, visual arts, fine arts, architecture, design, artists, art movements, museums, and related topics. Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations. Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives. Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality. Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in Art History, Fine Arts, Visual Arts, Museum Studies, Cultural Studies, Design, Humanities, or other art-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of art, including familiarity with major artists, artworks, art movements, styles, periods, techniques, museums, cultural traditions, and developments in visual arts. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in art research, academia, museums, galleries, curation, art criticism or journalism, education, publishing, arts and cultural content, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess artistic, historical, and cultural information accurately and within the appropriate context.

title: Senior accounting manager
description:
About MAVI

MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement.

The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.

Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and Soft Bank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounting Manager to run the accounting operation for US-based client companies, working remotely from Brazil.

This is a senior management seat reporting to the Controller or Head of Accounting, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will manage the close, manage the accounting team, and hold first-line accountability for the accuracy of what the function produces before it reaches final review.

Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who fixes them and writes down how they now work.

You will work closely with the finance leadership, and directly with the operators whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.

Because your team sits outside the United States and the leadership you report to does not, the role calls for someone who runs their area without needing to be managed through it, escalates early rather than at review, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture across a time difference.

What You'll Own

The Close and Financial Reporting

The close. Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, with accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time. The financial statements. Prepare the P& L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers your team produced. Review. Provide first-line review over journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and send nothing upward you have not satisfied yourself on. Revenue. Maintain revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules and the deferred revenue roll-forward, and prepare the judgements behind them for review. Consolidation. Prepare multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation. Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that leadership and investors rely on, with root-cause commentary rather than a restatement of the variance.

Controls, Policy, and Audit

Policies and controls. Maintain and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows, and recommend changes where the current design no longer fits the company's stage. Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow the function to run without depending on any single individual — including you. Audit. Manage the annual audit or review day to day, including PBC preparation, direct response to auditor queries, and resolution of findings, escalating significant matters to the Controller. External partners. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for US tax advisers and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding them to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations and Team

The transactional cycle. Manage the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards. Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them. Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast. The accounting team. Manage, review, mentor, and develop the accounting staff and bookkeepers reporting to you, and give the Controller an honest read on where each person stands. Finance systems. Lead ERP implementation and migration workstreams across Net Suite, Quick Books Online, and comparable platforms, and support platform selection.

What We're Looking For

8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct management of accounting staff Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage Experience managing an audit or review, including direct response to external auditors through to resolution of findings Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination A track record of tightening accounting processes and controls that were not working, and documenting them so they stayed fixed Substantial ERP experience with Net Suite, Quick Books Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, , or Rippling Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting Contador Público (CPN) matriculado, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred Experience through a first audit or an ERP implementation is highly regarded Saa S or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Who This Role Is For

This role is well suited to an accounting manager who wants to run an operation rather than administer one part of it.

You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion and show your work, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you. You are comfortable reviewing someone else's work and telling them plainly when it is not right, and equally comfortable being reviewed yourself.

title: Domain expert reviewer- science & technology
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Science & Technology Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in science and technology will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a broad range of scientific and technological topics.

Key Responsibilities Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, and related fields. Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, technical correctness, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations. Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives. Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality. Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or technically complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or other science and technology-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of science and technology, including physics, chemistry, biology, engineering principles, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, scientific research, and recent technological advancements. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in scientific research, engineering, technology, software development, academia, technical writing, science journalism, data science, AI, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate science and technology-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a broad range of scientific and technical topics.

Preferred Qualifications Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality. Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows. Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies. Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards. Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

Offer Details: Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Domain expert reviewer- sports
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Sports Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in sports will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a wide range of sporting disciplines.

Key Responsibilities Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering global sports, leagues, athletes, tournaments, rules, statistics, sports history, analytics, and related topics. Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations. Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives. Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality. Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in Sports Management, Sports Science, Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, or other sports-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of sports, including familiarity with major leagues, teams, athletes, tournaments, rules, statistics, and key developments across one or more sports. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in sports journalism, sports media, sports content, research, analysis, reporting, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess sports-related information accurately.

Preferred Qualifications Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality. Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows. Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies. Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards. Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

title: Senior marketing designer
description:
Senior Marketing Designer

Shoplift · Remote · August 2026

About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.

The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2 B Saa S marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2 B Saa S company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the Saa S . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2 C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by "brand recognizes brand" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.

This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.

How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse , and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.

You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.

What You'll Do

Marketing creative & campaign assets Design static ad systems for Meta, Linked In, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.

You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2 B Saa S portfolio Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves Motion design or animation Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention

How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. " It looked great" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.

What We Offer Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually Flexible remote work Generous time off policy Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand Build your portfolio with high-quality B2 B Saa S work that stands out Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product

How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2 B Saa S marketing work) One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked. How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

title: Domain expert reviewer- music
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Music Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in music will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse music-related topics.

Key Responsibilities Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering music theory, genres, composers, artists, music history, production, instruments, and related topics. Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations. Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives. Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality. Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Music, Music Theory, Musicology, Ethnomusicology, Music Education, Music Production, Audio Engineering, Performing Arts, or other music-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of music, including music theory, composition, genres, composers, artists, instruments, music history, production techniques, notation, and contemporary music trends. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in music education, performance, composition, music production, journalism, research, content creation, audio engineering, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate music-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across diverse musical topics.

Preferred Qualifications Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality. Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or content evaluation workflows. Strong knowledge of music theory, genres, composers, artists, instruments, music production, and music history. Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards. Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

Offer Details: Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

description:
About Turing:

Key Responsibilities: Create advanced prompts covering fine arts, visual arts, architecture, design, art history, museums, and artists. Develop benchmark datasets and adversarial test cases. Provide evidence-based feedback with reliable references. Collaborate with AI researchers to improve model performance. Strong knowledge of art, including familiarity with major artists, artworks, art movements, styles, periods, techniques, museums, cultural traditions, and developments in visual arts. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in art research, academia, museums, galleries, curation, art criticism or journalism, education, publishing, arts and cultural content, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess artistic, historical, and cultural information accurately and within the appropriate context.

Preferred Qualifications: Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation. Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus. Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews.

title: Mid-level accountant
description:
Company Description:

4 ARC Consulting provides outsourced accounting, financial operations, and fractional CFO services to small and mid-sized businesses across multiple industries. We support clients with accurate financial reporting, streamlined accounting processes, and actionable financial insights.

We are growing our accounting team and looking for a Mid-Level Accountant who is detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable supporting multiple U. S.-based clients.

Responsibilities

Perform day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities for multiple client accounts. Categorize and review transactions and maintain accurate general ledger records. Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations. Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and other month-end adjustments. Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close. Review accounts payable and accounts receivable activity. Record and reconcile payroll entries based on payroll reports. Prepare and review Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss statements, and other financial reports. Investigate account discrepancies and resolve reconciliation issues. Maintain supporting schedules and accounting documentation. Assist with accounting cleanups, catch-up projects, and system migrations. Work with senior accounting and finance professionals to support client reporting and financial analysis. Communicate professionally with the 4 ARC team regarding open items, missing documentation, and accounting issues. Support multiple clients while meeting established deadlines and maintaining confidentiality.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. 3–5+ years of accounting experience preferred. Strong understanding of accounting principles, general ledger accounting, and month-end close. Experience with bank reconciliations, journal entries, AP, AR, and financial statement preparation. Experience with Quick Books Online strongly preferred. Experience with systems such as Sage Intacct, Net Suite, SAP, or similar ERP/accounting platforms is a plus. Experience supporting U. S.-based companies or working with U. S. GAAP is a strong plus. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify accounting discrepancies independently. Ability to manage multiple companies, clients, and deadlines simultaneously. Professional written and verbal communication skills in English. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a U. S.-based team.

What We're Looking For:

We are looking for someone who goes beyond basic data entry. The right candidate should understand how transactions flow through the financial statements, recognize when something does not look correct, investigate discrepancies, and take ownership of assigned accounting work.

You should be organized, proactive, comfortable asking questions when needed, and capable of working independently once processes and expectations are established.

description: ABOUT SHEIN SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. About the job About the Role We are seeking a Senior Warehouse Supervisor to oversee daily logistics operations within a business unit, ensuring operational efficiency, productivity, quality, and compliance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs). This role will be responsible for coordinating warehouse activities across Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory , ensuring that operational processes are executed effectively and that teams are properly guided and supported to achieve business objectives. The professional will also play an important role in monitoring operational performance, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, solving operational issues, and implementing corrective actions to enhance overall warehouse performance. Lead and engage employees in compliance with Occupational Health and Safety, Quality, and Environmental policies , as well as company standards and procedures. Ensure the effective execution and maintenance of existing operational processes, while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and greater efficiency. Oversee key warehouse activities, including Receiving, Stocking, Shipping, Sorting, and Inventory , prioritizing and distributing tasks according to operational needs. Provide guidance and support to the team, addressing operational challenges and resolving issues that may impact productivity, quality, or service levels. Monitor operational progress and performance, identifying deviations and implementing corrective actions to ensure compliance with SLAs, productivity targets, and quality standards. Track and analyze key operational performance indicators (KPIs), using data and logistics studies to identify trends, operational gaps, and opportunities to improve overall warehouse performance. Coordinate physical inventory activities, ensuring proper execution and taking the necessary actions to maintain inventory accuracy. Contribute to the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of quality standards within the area of responsibility. Provide regular feedback, guidance, and performance insights to leaders and coordinators, supporting team development and operational excellence. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment between logistics operations and broader business requirements. Requirements Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management , or a related field. 3+ years of professional experience in logistics or supply chain, preferably with experience in logistics operations, continuous improvement, distribution, supply chain, or demand planning. Previous experience supervising or coordinating logistics or warehouse operations. Strong problem-solving and data analysis skills , with the ability to interpret operational data and make sound, data-driven decisions. Demonstrated ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical solutions to improve productivity, quality, and service levels. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with customers, peers, direct reports, and cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities while maintaining operational excellence. Advanced English proficiency. Availability to work shifts in Guarulhos. Preferred Qualifications Experience in large-scale warehouse, fulfillment, distribution center, or e-commerce operations. Experience with KPI management, operational performance analysis, inventory accuracy, and continuous improvement initiatives. Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies. Experience working in high-volume and rapidly changing logistics environments.

title: Product designer mobile & web | remote
description:
Ambanga Technologies is a small, fast-moving technology company building mobile and web products. Most of our team is based in Brazil, with a few of us internationally, and we work very closely across design, product and development.

We’re expanding our design team and looking for a strong Product Designer to join us.

We’re looking for someone with great attention to detail, strong product thinking and a real startup attitude . You need to be someone who looks beyond the screen you’ve been asked to design. Someone who asks questions, spots things others might miss and thinks about how the whole experience works for the user.

The role

You’ll work across our products, taking ownership of design work from early ideas through to implementation. You’ll work closely with Product, developers, QA and the wider team, and will need to be comfortable adapting as priorities change.

The role will include:

Product discovery and exploring new ideas Turning early ideas into clear user journeys Researching competitors and how other products solve similar problems Wireframes, user flows and high-fidelity designs Creating prototypes for user interviews and testing Designing across i OS, Android and web Working with and improving our design systems Working closely with developers throughout implementation Improving designs based on feedback and what we learn from real users Occasionally helping with other design or creative work across the business

There’s a lot going on and plenty to learn, so no two days are exactly the same.

What matters to us

Attention to detail is a big one.

We need someone who naturally spots things that don’t quite make sense — a missing state, an unclear action, an inconsistency or something in a journey that could confuse the user.

We also want someone who can work independently. You won’t always be given a perfectly written brief. Sometimes you’ll get an idea or a problem and need to research it, ask the right questions and come back with possible solutions.

You should be curious and proactive. Look at what other products are doing, bring new ideas to the team and be willing to challenge something if you think there’s a better way of doing it.

We’re a very collaborative team, so you need to be comfortable sharing your work, receiving feedback and changing direction when needed. We move quickly and priorities can change, so being flexible is important. Sometimes something else becomes more important and we all need to jump in and help.

We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership of their work . The job doesn’t finish when a design is handed over to development. We expect our designers to look at what has actually been built, use it and help make sure the final experience is right.

What we're looking for

Relevant experience as a Product / UX/UI Designer A strong portfolio showing real digital products you’ve worked on Experience designing for mobile and web Good understanding of i OS and Android UX patterns Experience with discovery, user flows and prototyping Experience creating prototypes for interviews and user testing Experience working with design systems Comfortable working closely with developers Able to work independently and take ownership of a piece of work Very strong attention to detail Curious, proactive and happy to bring ideas to the table Comfortable working in a startup where things can move quickly Fluent English , written and spoken

The setup

Remote Contractor / PJ Monday to Friday The team starts at 7:30am Brazil time , so you need to be available for our daily meetings and team discussions Looking for someone who can start as soon as possible

Please include a link to your Product Design portfolio in your CV.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small design challenge and then talk us through how they approached it and why they made the decisions they did.

title: Revenue accountant
description:
US Accounting Ownership. Long-Term Global Partnerships.

MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly into their finance operations. This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.

You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. Your accuracy and process ownership directly support business growth.

What You Will Own

Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and Rev Ops on deal structuring and billing questions Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle

What We're Looking For

4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact ERP experience (Net Suite, Sage Intacct, Quick Books, or equivalent) Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow Strong analytical and organizational skills Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant Availability for US time zone overlap

Preferred

Saa S, marketplace, or usage-based revenue experience, including ARR and NRR mechanics Experience with billing and revenue platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora, Maxio, Recurly, or Net Suite ARM CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit

Why Join MAVI?

Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles Flexible remote-first work culture Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

title: Domain expert - geography
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Geography Domain Expert to evaluate and improve Large Language Models (LLMs). You will design challenging prompts, assess factual accuracy and reasoning, and identify knowledge gaps within physical and human geography, GIS concepts, climate, geopolitics, and demographics.

Key Responsibilities: Create advanced prompts covering physical and human geography, GIS concepts, climate, geopolitics, and demographics. Evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and nuance. Identify hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, outdated information, and edge cases. Develop benchmark datasets and adversarial test cases. Provide evidence-based feedback with reliable references. Collaborate with AI researchers to improve model performance. Maintain high annotation quality and documentation.

Day - to - day task: Write domain-specific prompts of varying difficulty. Compare multiple AI responses and rank them. Explain why a response is correct or incorrect using authoritative references. Identify ambiguous questions and propose improved prompts.

Minimum Qualifications: Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in Geography, Human Geography, Physical Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Studies, Urban Studies, International Studies, or other geography-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of geography, including familiarity with countries, regions, cities, physical features, populations, cultures, political boundaries, human geography, and/or physical geography. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in geographic research, academia, education, geospatial analysis, journalism, publishing, research, geographic content development, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess geographic, regional, demographic, and spatial information accurately.

Preferred Qualifications: Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation. Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus. Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews. Offer Details:

Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap

title: Bilingual paralegal / legal assistant
description:
Company Description

Catalyze X is a leading outsourcing partner specializing in delivering cost-effective and highly efficient labor solutions to businesses across various industries. We help companies scale their operations and achieve sustainable growth by providing top-tier talent and support.

Role Description

Catalyze X is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Bilingual Paralegal (Spanish/English) to join our remote legal team. In this role, you will oversee the full lifecycle of case managementfrom intake through case closingserving as a central hub for document management and case organization. You will support attorneys and senior paralegals, ensuring all case materials are accurate, properly filed, and easily accessible, while helping maintain smooth workflows across the team.

Key Responsibilities

Case Intake & Opening Process all new client intake information and documentation. Create and organize new case files in legal case management systems. Prepare engagement letters, conflict checks, intake forms, and other opening documents. Coordinate with attorneys to ensure complete and accurate intake information. Maintain case opening checklists to ensure consistency across all matters.

Case Management & Closing Monitor ongoing cases and ensure case data is accurate and up-to-date. Coordinate with attorneys to identify cases ready for closure. Execute case closing procedures, including final billing, archiving documents, and updating case status. Prepare case closing memoranda and coordinate return or destruction of client materials.

Document Management & Discovery Serve as the central resource for locating and retrieving case documents and discovery materials. Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems with consistent naming conventions. Manage discovery materials, including indexing, tracking, and archiving. Conduct periodic audits of case files to ensure compliance with filing standards. Support attorneys and staff in document preparation, version control, and proper storage.

Administrative & Client Support Provide general administrative support, including managing emails, phone calls, and calendars. Assist with scheduling meetings and coordinating case-related communications. Serve as a secondary point of contact for clients, providing updates and addressing inquiries. Draft, file, and process legal documents and correspondence as assigned.

Qualifications Bilingual: Spanish and English proficiency required; must be based in Brazil or Latin America. Strong American English communication skills (spoken and written). Knowledge of legal procedures, case management, and document handling. Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities with strong attention to detail. Experience with legal case management software and cloud-based document systems. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a fast-paced environment. Background in workers' compensation and personal injury law preferred.

Technical Requirements

Internet connection: High-speed internet required — minimum 20 Mbps or fiber connection

Computer / laptop: Employees must use a genuine, supported business laptop with built-in hardware security and full-disk encryption enabled. Unsupported, modified, bypass-installed, rooted, or jailbroken operating systems are not permitted.

Windows: Windows 11 (preferably Windows 11 Pro), 2021 model or newer, with TPM 2.0 enabled and Bit Locker / Windows Device Encryption turned on Mac: Apple Mac Book / Mac, 2020 model or newer, preferably Apple Silicon M1 or newer, running a supported mac OS version with File Vault enabled Not permitted: Chromebooks (Chrome OS), tablets, and mobile devices are not supported and cannot be used for this role

RAM: Minimum 8 GB (16 GB preferred)

Noise-canceling headset

Power and internet backup required

Compensation: $7 per hour

Working Hours: Eastern or Pacific Time Zone

If you are highly organized, proactive, and eager to contribute to a growing legal team, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your application through our Careers Page ; only applications submitted via the career page form will be considered.
